findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: extract_page, robots, headers, nip05_register, list_me · Private data: dns_lookup, emailcheck, evm_balance, evm_token, evm_tx, list_me · Public sink: leads, emailcheck, broken_sites_leads, list_me.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: extract_page, robots, headers, nip05_register, list_me · Private data: dns_lookup, emailcheck, evm_balance, evm_token, evm_tx, list_me · Public sink: leads, emailcheck, broken_sites_leads, list_me

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
